newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania OTC market dips, fresh lows expected.
newsitem.headline: Romania OTC market dips, fresh lows expected.

text.p: Romania's over-the-counter (OTC) market fell on Thursday under strong selling pressure, operators said.
They said foreign investors were still waiting for new government portfolio investment rules and expected heavy foreign buying after the legislation was put in place.
On the shorter term, they saw the downtrend continuing.

Independent index VAB-RASDAQ, computed by VANGUARD securities, dipped by 3.16 percent from the previous session to 3,325.8 points. Another unofficial index, the BIG-OTC compiled by BIG brokers, edged down by 5.01 percent to 2,396.29 points.
Market attractions cement maker Romcim and steel mill Sidex closed 2,000 and 1,500 lei weaker at 67,500 and respectively 11,500 in heavy supply.
Oil refinery Arpechim ended 4,500 lei higher at 17,500, but dealers said the stock had been highly volatile throughout the day due to speculative deals.
Plane maker IAR shed 1,000 lei to close at 34,000 in subdued trading.
Thursday's turnover slid to 6.02 billion lei from 11.34 billion on Wednesday, while volumes fell to 2.17 million shares from 3.83 million previous day.
